sources.recipe: ATCC Hybri-Care Medium Hybri-Care Medium is supplied as a powder and should be reconstituted in 1 L cell culture grade water + 10% FBS 1.5 g/L sodium bicarbonate for use with 5% CO2 in air atmosphere.
